VF_KB_API_KEY.description: API key for accessing the VF knowledge base, enabling advanced knowledge retrieval capabilities.

roundedImageURL.description: URL pointing to the rounded image asset used to visually represent the agent.

rectangeImageURL.description: URL pointing to the rectangular image asset for the agent's branding or display.

messageDelayMS.description: Specifies the delay in milliseconds for the agent to send messages, simulating natural conversation timing.

scrollAnimation.description: Indicates whether scroll animations are enabled for smooth transitions in the chat interface.

proactiveMessage.description: A predefined message the agent sends proactively to engage users.

acceptFileUpload.description: Determines if the agent accepts file uploads from users as part of the interaction.

recordChatHistory.description: Specifies whether the agent logs chat histories for future reference or analysis.

chatBgURL.description: URL of the background image used in the chat interface.

disableSmoothScroll.description: Disables smooth scrolling if set to true, potentially improving performance on low-end devices.

isDeployed.description: Indicates whether the agent is currently deployed and operational.

tokensUsage.description: Tracks the token usage statistics for the agent, typically used in LLM integrations.

maxTokensUsage.description: Defines the maximum allowable token usage for the agent to prevent overconsumption.

fontFamily.description: The font family used in the agent's user interface for consistent branding.

branding.description: Custom branding information or labels associated with the agent.

customThemeJSONString.description: A JSON string defining a custom theme for the agent's interface.

autoStartWidget.description: Determines if the widget should auto-start upon page load.

allTimeTriggers.description: The total number of triggers or interactions the agent has handled.

syncBrowser.description: Enables synchronization of settings or states with the browser session.

delayBeforeSubmit.description: The delay (in milliseconds) before submitting user input to the agent.

messageAggregationSeconds.description: Number of seconds the AI should wait and aggregate consecutive user messages (text + images) before triggering a single reply. Applies globally to all text-based channels (Web, WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Telegram, SMS, Discord). Runtime default/floor is 5 seconds so image+follow-up text merge into one turn. Higher values further debounce; every new inbound message resets the wait timer.

listenForUrlChanges.description: Specifies if the agent should monitor and react to changes in the browser URL.

chatForget.description: If enabled, the agent will not retain previous chat interactions for privacy reasons.

lang.description: Specifies the default language for the agent's interactions and responses.

enableAudioSupport.description: Enables audio features, allowing the agent to process and respond to audio inputs.

AITranslateTo.description: Defines the target language for AI translation during interactions.

enableAITranslate.description: Activates AI-based translation for multilingual support.

disableNoReplyListener.description: Disables the listener for instances where no reply is detected from the agent.

disableHumanHandoff.description: Prevents the agent from escalating interactions to a human operator.

alwaysShowHandoff.description: Ensures the handoff option is always visible, regardless of agent status.

manualControl.description: Allows manual control over specific agent functionalities.

enableVGHandoff.description: Activates VG-specific handoff mechanisms for the agent.

enableGeoAnalytics.description: Enables geographic analytics to track user interactions based on location.

hideVoiceflowAnalytics.description: Hides Voiceflow-specific analytics including intents, conversation flow metrics, and rating analytics.

hideCallAnalytics.description: Hides voice call analytics including duration, latency, cost breakdown, call counts, and call end reasons.

hideConversationMetrics.description: Hides conversation metrics including user retention, conversation length, time retention, and engagement metrics.

hideCustomAnalytics.description: Hides user-created custom charts and metrics from the analytics dashboard.

hideVapiAnalytics.description: Hides VAPI-specific analytics including cost tracking and voice-related metrics.

hideFunnelAnalytics.description: Hides the user engagement funnel chart that tracks progression from widget views to high engagement.

hideHandoffAnalytics.description: Hides handoff analytics including accepted handover count, average response time, and average handling time metrics.

fixedHandoffPopup.description: Ensures the handoff popup remains fixed in the interface.

ADVANCED_customCSS.description: Specifies advanced custom CSS for overriding the default styling of the agent's interface.

messagesLimit.description: Sets a cap on the number of messages the agent can exchange in a single session.

whatsappToken.description: Token for authenticating and integrating with WhatsApp services.

whatsappNumberId.description: The ID associated with the WhatsApp number used by the agent.

whatsappBusniessId.description: The business ID for WhatsApp integration, enabling enterprise-level features.

waTestNumber.description: A test number used during WhatsApp integration setup or testing.

waVerifyPassed.description: Indicates if WhatsApp verification was successfully completed.

waTestPassed.description: Indicates if the WhatsApp integration test was successful.

twilioSmsAccountSid.description: Twilio Account SID for SMS integration.

twilioSmsAuthToken.description: Twilio Auth Token for SMS integration (encrypted).

twilioSmsPhoneNumber.description: Twilio phone number for SMS integration.

twilioSmsVerified.description: Indicates if the Twilio SMS integration is verified.

twilioSmsPhoneNumberSid.description: Twilio IncomingPhoneNumber SID for platform rental numbers (used for releasing).

twilioSmsRentalSubscriptionId.description: Stripe subscription ID for platform rental SMS number billing.

webhookUrl.description: The URL where the agent sends webhook events to external systems.

gcloudPrivateKey.description: Private key for Google Cloud services integration.

gcloudClientEmail.description: Client email for Google Cloud authentication.

smartInit.description: Activates smart initialization features for the agent.

UIhandoffTitle.description: Title displayed during UI handoff interactions.

UIhandoffSubtitle.description: Subtitle displayed during UI handoff interactions.

igVerified.description: Indicates if the agent's Instagram integration is verified.

igAccessToken.description: Access token for authenticating Instagram API requests.

showHandoffEvenIfOffline.description: Displays the handoff option even if the agent is offline.

persistHandoffOnRefresh.description: Maintains handoff state when users refresh or close their browser tabs.

enableBugReporting.description: Enables bug reporting module in the conversation's controls.

blockInputDuringHandoffRequest.description: Blocks chat input when a user requests human handoff but no human has been assigned yet. Only applies to VF agents.

disableHandoffMessages.description: When enabled, the system will not send automatic messages when handoff occurs (e.g., 'Now chatting with John').

disableHandoffStatusMessages.description: When enabled, the system will not send status messages during handoff transitions (e.g., 'We are connecting you to a human', 'Handoff cancelled', 'No agent was available').

customButtonJSON_STRING.description: JSON string defining custom buttons for the agent's interface.

vg_initPrompt.description: LEGACY single-prompt only (enableNodes === false): opening/init user turn for the classic Prompt-tab agent. Ignored when enableNodes is true - new agents use nodes (start node), tools, and variables instead.

vg_prompt.description: LEGACY single-prompt only (enableNodes === false): classic main prompt template. Ignored for nodes agents - use node instructions / tools / variables.

vg_systemPrompt.description: LEGACY single-prompt only (enableNodes === false): system instructions for the classic Prompt-tab agent. Ignored when enableNodes is true - system behavior lives on nodes (and tools/variables), not these vg_* fields.

vg_temperature.description: LEGACY single-prompt only (enableNodes === false): LLM temperature for the classic agent. Nodes agents set model/temperature per node (or nodesSettings), not via this field.

vg_maxTokens.description: LEGACY single-prompt only (enableNodes === false): max tokens for the classic agent. Nodes agents configure token limits per node / nodesSettings instead.

vg_kbDefaultDimension.description: Default dimensionality for the agent's knowledge base embeddings.

vg_kbTopChunks.description: The number of top chunks retrieved from the knowledge base during a query.

SECRET_API_KEY.description: The secret API key for secure integration with VF services.

vg_kbCharCount.description: Tracks the total character count of the agent's knowledge base.

vg_kbDocsNum.description: The total number of documents stored in the agent's knowledge base.

vg_enableUIEngine.description: Activates the UI engine for enhanced interface capabilities.

vg_enableAboutContext.description: Enables contextual information about the agent for users.

vg_enableUIEngineForms.description: Enables form and input components in the UI engine for web channel.

vg_enableUIEngineInvoice.description: Enables the invoice card component in the UI engine for web channel.

vg_enableUIEngineCalendarBooking.description: Enables the interactive calendar booking widget in the UI engine for web channel.

vg_max_messages_history.description: Maximum number of messages retained in the chat history.

ifKnowsThreshold.description: Confidence threshold for determining if the agent 'knows' an answer.

avatarImageUrl.description: URL of the avatar image representing the agent.

headerImageUrl.description: URL of the header image displayed in the chat interface.

bannerImageUrl.description: URL of the banner image used in the agent's branding.

soundEffectUrl.description: URL of the sound effect file used for agent interactions.

soundEffectEnabled.description: Enables or disables sound effects for the agent.

enableQuickFileUpload.description: Allows quick file uploads during chat interactions.

enableNodes.description: Agent framework switch. true (default for new agents) = nodes/canvas runtime: use nodes, tools, and variables - ignore legacy vg_systemPrompt / vg_initPrompt / vg_prompt / vg_initMessages / vg_defaultModel / vg_temperature / vg_maxTokens for routing. false = classic single-prompt agent that still uses those vg_* Prompt-tab fields.

enableFallback.description: Enable fallback for the agent llm model.

disableRating.description: Whether to disable the chat end rating feature.

chatEndMessage.description: The message to show when the chat ends.

aiIntroductionMessage.description: The message to show when the user starts the chat on metachannels.

enableAIIntroductionMessage.description: Whether to enable the AI introduction message or not.

deployed.description: Whether the agent is deployed or not.

captureIGStories.description: Whether to capture instagram stories or not.

gdprCompliance.description: Whether to comply with GDPR or not.

disableButtonAnimation.description: When true, disables NextUI button press-scale animation.

disableButtonRipple.description: When true, disables NextUI button ripple.

disableInputAnimation.description: When true, disables NextUI input focus/label animations.

object_42be1b26.description: This is the overrides to use for the agent.

supportWorkspaceAuthToken.description: Short-lived server-signed token authorizing support-agent workspace resolution for this interaction.

schemaCrawlJobId.description: When set with agentProfileId=schema_crawl_operator_v1, binds the built-in operator session to this scrape job.

currentNode.description: Current node to resume the call from.

awaitListenUrl.description: If true, the call will wait for the listen url to be generated before starting the call.

currentNode.description: Current node to resume the call from.

awaitListenUrl.description: If true, the call will wait for the listen url to be generated before starting the call.

object_fde53999.description: Agent runtime overrides (tools, variables, messagesHistory, etc.).

dryRun.description: Validate and return the resolved send plan without sending.

createConvo.description: Create or update the SMS conversation record. Defaults to true.

persistToConvo.description: Persist outbound message metadata on the conversation. Defaults to true.

skipIfHumanHandoff.description: Skip sending when the conversation is in human-chatting handoff state.

splitLongMessages.description: Split messages longer than 1600 chars into multiple SMS segments.

sendViaEdge.description: Deliver through the edge SMS sender so transcripts and multi-segment replies stay consistent.

disableRecordHistory.description: When using agent mode, skip saving the agent turn to Firebase history.

initialPrompt.description: Prompt passed to the agent in agent mode. Defaults to a generic outbound SMS opener.

messagingServiceSid.description: Twilio Messaging Service SID (own-account mode only).

provideFeedback.description: Request delivery feedback from Twilio (own-account mode only).

smartEncoded.description: Enable Twilio smart encoding for GSM-7/Unicode optimization.

object_4fce821e.description: Advanced options for outbound SMS delivery and conversation handling.

id.description: Stable tool id / declaration name used by the runtime.

name.description: Tool name exposed to the LLM.

description.description: When / how the tool should be used.

kind.description: assignable_system = enable via nodes[].toolsIds; runtime_auto = injected by the LLM runtime (not created via Tools CRUD).

assignableViaToolsIds.description: If true, include this id in nodes[].toolsIds on PATCH /agents/{id} to enable it.

variablesIds.description: System variable keys this tool reads/writes.

channels.description: Channels where this tool is supported.

notes.description: Extra runtime / eligibility notes for API consumers.

DefaultLlmToolsCatalog.description: Full catalog of built-in default system tools + runtime LLM tools (KB-Search, present, etc.).

DefaultLlmToolKind.description: assignable_system = enable via nodes[].toolsIds; runtime_auto = injected by the LLM runtime (not created via Tools CRUD).

CustomToolId.description: Custom tool id returned by POST /agents/{agentId}/tools (Firestore tools collection).
